crossRefs.note: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos, and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to…
But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and sat…
But Paul didn’t think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and…
